full_prompt_en: A square decorative illustration shows a white country house set back behind a broad golden-brown tree in a crowded woodland. The tree trunk rises from near the lower center and divides into thick curving branches that spread across most of the upper frame. Its canopy is packed with small, blue-gray leaves and dark interwoven lines, forming a patterned ceiling over the building. The house has white plaster walls with a dark base and slate-colored roofs; several narrow windows with warm tan frames punctuate its uneven façade. A dark arched doorway sits near the lower middle, partly obscured by the foreground trunk. On the left and right, pale slender trees stand almost like vertical borders, their branches folding into the dense canopy. The ground in front is heaped with rounded gray-green stones, shrubs, and irregular low foliage, leaving no clear open path to the house. Deep ink-like outlines define the house edges, roots, rocks, and leaf clusters, while lighter fills allow the intricate pattern to remain readable. Warm gold on the central bark contrasts with the cool blue, sage, and charcoal vegetation. The light is diffuse and even, with little cast shadow; depth comes instead from layers of overlapping foliage and the house sitting behind the giant trunk. Fine speckles and a slightly aged paper tone soften the precision of the linework. Although the scene contains many small elements, the powerful central tree holds them in a balanced arrangement. The overall composition is intricate and sheltered, combining architectural order with a richly patterned, almost tapestry-like woodland surface.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形装饰性插画描绘白色乡间房屋退在宽大的金棕色树后，周围林地十分茂密。树干从下方中央附近升起，分成粗厚弯曲的枝条，铺展到上方大部分画面。树冠挤满细小蓝灰叶片与交织暗线，在房屋上方形成纹样般的顶棚。房屋有白色灰泥墙、深色基座和石板色屋顶，数扇窄窗以暖褐色窗框点缀不规则的立面。深色拱门位于下方中央附近，被前景树干部分遮住。左右两侧的浅色细树几乎像竖向边框，枝条也折入浓密树冠。前面的地面堆满圆润的灰绿石块、灌木和不规则低矮叶丛，没留下通向房子的清楚空路。深墨线勾出房屋边缘、树根、岩石和叶簇，较浅的填色让复杂纹样仍可读。中央树皮的暖金色与冷蓝、鼠尾草绿和炭灰色植物相对。光线漫射而均匀，几乎没有投影；纵深主要来自叶丛的层叠以及位于巨树后方的房屋。细微斑点和略有年代感的纸色柔化了线条的精确。虽然场景里有许多小元素，强大的中央树仍把它们维系成平衡布局。整体构图复杂而受到庇护，把建筑的秩序与如挂毯般丰富的林地表面结合。
style_prompt_en: The image uses finely outlined decorative illustration with dense interlaced patterning and a slightly aged paper surface. Cool sage, slate blue, and charcoal fill most areas, balanced by muted ocher and warm cream accents. Curving lines and clustered small marks build broad masses from many legible fragments, while larger verticals keep the composition ordered. Edges are ink-dark and deliberate, though soft granular fills prevent a hard digital flatness. Illumination stays diffuse; depth is expressed primarily by overlapping silhouettes, tonal layering, and small shifts in scale. Decorative detail extends across the frame without losing a clear central anchor, creating a sheltered, intricate, tapestry-like effect.
style_prompt_zh: 图像采用细线勾勒的装饰性插画，交织纹样密集，表面略带旧纸质感。冷鼠尾草绿、石板蓝与炭灰色占据大部分区域，以低饱和赭色和暖奶油色平衡。弯曲线条与聚集的小笔痕把许多可辨的碎片组织成宽大体量，较大的竖线让构图保持秩序。边缘以深墨色有意勾定，柔软颗粒填色则避免僵硬的数字平涂。照明保持漫射；纵深主要通过剪影重叠、影调分层和细微尺度变化表达。装饰细节延伸至全画面却不失清楚的中央支点，形成受到庇护、繁复而如挂毯般的效果。
theme_en: A white country house behind an ornate tree in a decorative woodland illustration
theme_zh: 装饰性林地插画里，一栋白色乡间房屋藏在繁复大树后
name: CFA Voysey
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
